title: Loop de Loop
intro: Twenty-six instructions, eight blocks. Do the math. [b]repeat[/b] runs the blocks inside it as many times as you say. The path also needs more stamina than you have, so grab the battery on the way.
cs_note: A [b]loop[/b] says "do this N times" instead of writing it N times. Batteries refill stamina but never above the maximum, so picking one up when you're nearly full wastes some of it.
hints: Drop blocks inside the repeat block's mouth to loop them.
Three straight runs: 10 east, 6 north, 8 west.
